observations: Photo 0 and photo 1 show a light-colored wooden pallet on a concrete floor with intact slats and blocks.
Photo 2 shows darker, weathered wooden pallets stacked outdoors with visible wear and staining.
No size markings, brand stamps, or model numbers are visible on any pallet in the photos.
The seller's text is a general description of pallet use, not a specific claim about condition, quantity, or dimensions.

risks.risk: Structural damage, cracks, rot, or missing nails not visible in the photos, especially on the weathered pallets in photo 2.
risks.proof: Close-up photos or video of each pallet's underside, stringers, blocks, and nail heads.

risks.risk: Unknown dimensions; the pallets may not be a standard size.
risks.proof: Photo with a tape measure showing length, width, and height.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-standard or unknown size

risks.risk: No visible ISPM 15 heat-treatment or IPPC stamp; may not comply with export or logistics rules.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of any HT or IPPC stamp on the wood.

risks.risk: Quantity is unclear; the photos may show only a sample of a larger lot.
risks.proof: Photo showing the full stack or lot with a visible count.

risks.risk: Contamination from prior cargo (chemicals, food, moisture) cannot be ruled out remotely.
risks.proof: Close inspection for stains, odors, or residue, plus seller disclosure.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the underside and stringers of each pallet to check for cracks, rot, or missing nails.
Tape-measure photo showing pallet length, width, and height.
Close-up of any heat-treatment or IPPC stamp on the wood.
Photo showing the full quantity of pallets being sold.
response.reason: The item is clearly a wooden pallet and can be priced at its worst case—damaged, unknown size, untreated, single unit—while listing the proof needed to raise the value.
